 Bolex Reporter, Volume 10
 Winter 1959
 Volume 10, Number 1
 Articles: "'Twas the Night Before Christmas", Molly Malone Cook; "Stop Action", Tom Sullivan; "You Put It On the Screen", Bill Lewis; "Let It Snow", George Nagorsky; "A Day In the Life of a Museum", Charles Gellis; "Adventure on the Beach", Robert C. Hermes; "Three Faces of Kim", Robert Newman; "Movies Help Analyze Basketball", Harold Hainfeld; "An Introduction to Home Movies (Part V)", Raymond C. Lawson; "Try Ski Movies", Myron A. Matzkin
 The center section of this issue includes "Bolex Christmas Gift Ideas"; a shopping guide, organized into four price groups, to help the reader choose Bolex gifts for friends and family.
 32 pages
 Spring 1960
 Volume 10, Number 2
 Articles: "Our Bolex Had Two Heads", Chalmers Sisters; "Spring, Gentle Spring (Your Movie Script, No. 2)", Bill Lewis; "Second Chance", Andrew G. Skalkeas; "For Boating... Spring Is Fix-Up Time", Ray Dantzler; "Old West Comes to Life", Tom Sullivan; "Sound on Film", Ernst Wildi; "When Nature Awakens", David S. Brown; "An Introduction to Home Movies (Part VI)", Raymond C. Lawson; "Improve Your Swing With Film Loops", Harold Hainfeld and Dick Flanagan; "Indians I Have Shot", Merrill F. Sproul, Jr.
 The newly introduced Bolex Sonorizer, for recording magnetic sound on film, is introduced and reviewed in this issue.
 32 pages
 Summer 1960
 Volume 10, Number 3
 Articles: "Bolex Goes Underground", Charles Gellis and Thos Guarino; "More Camera Magic", Tom Sullivan; "The Moving Eye", Ira Latour and Hugh Pennebaker; "The Game Nobody Saw", Albert Fleishman; "Underwater Movies Expand Scope of Scuba Set", Burton McNeely; "And Now We Add Sound", Ernst Wildi; "To Zoom or Not to Zoom", Merrill F. Sproul, Jr.; "Film Your Own West Point Story", Harold Hainfeld; "How to Get From There to Here", Bill Lewis; "In A Wedding Movie, It's the Little Things", David S. Brown; "An Introduction to Home Movies (Part VI)", Raymond C. Lawson; "Casper of the Klondike", Merrill F. Sproul, Jr.
 An intact copy of this issue would normally include a blue brochure for 8mm equipment, stapled to the center of the magazine.
 32 pages
 Fall 1960
 Volume 10, Number 4
 Articles: "An Airport, Your Bolex, and A Challenge", Ray Dantzler; "Newsreel Movie Aids Police School", Tom Sullivan; "A Real Cool Film", Alex Siodmak; "Looking at Our School", Charles Gellis and Thos Guarino; "High Schools Make Traffic Movies", Harold Hainfeld; "A Squire In Training for Knighthood", Robert Newman; "Directing Amateur Movie Actors", Bill Lewis; "An Introduction to Home Movies (Part VIII)", Raymond C. Lawson; "One More Horse Story", Chalmers Sisters; "Shoot Your Own Thanksgiving Turkey", Dan Pendenglasser, III; "The Amateur (Advanced Class)", John Carmizzaro
 Both the Pan Cinor 40 (8mm) and the S-221 projector are reviewed at length, in separate articles.
 32 pages
